summary: 10 kW bidirectional single-phase dual-active-bridge DC/DC power stage (700-800 V primary, 250-500 V secondary, 100 kHz) using discrete TO-247-4 SiC MOSFETs, one UCC21710 isolated gate driver plus one UCC14141-Q1 isolated bias module per switch, planar transformer with integrated series inductance, film DC-link capacitors with ceramic high-frequency capacitors, isolated shunt/divider/Hall sensing and a C2000 control card.

license.notes: TI 'Important Notice and Disclaimer' bundled in every archive (2024 Important Notice.pdf) and on design guide p.81: permission is granted only to use the resources for developing an application with the TI products described; other reproduction and display is prohibited. Only original AIPE analysis, metadata, file inventories and links are committed.

evidence_limitations: Design guide TIDUES0 Rev F (April 2026) describes hardware E4 / CAD Rev D; earlier-revision text survives in places (gate-driver loss section names UCC21530 while the BOM and circuit description use UCC21710).

Altium binary sources (.PcbDoc/.SchDoc) were inventoried but not parsed; no Altium installation or open parser is available in this environment. Netlist-level claims for TIDA-010054 therefore rest on the PDF schematic, BOM and design-guide figures, not a machine-read netlist.

Layout observations come from visual inspection of the 1:1 layer-plot PDF (TIDRZW3) rendered to images; copper weight, dielectric thicknesses and clearance values were not readable as text (fab notes are Gerber graphics) and are not recorded.
Efficiency, thermal and loss figures are TI's stated results under TI's test conditions (room ambient, two fans); they were not reproduced.
Thermal analysis in the guide uses a simplified series thermal model with an assumed 40 degC ambient; no measured junction temperatures are reported.

ratings.efficiency_claim: 98.7% peak, 98% full load (design guide front page); Table 1-1 text also states 97.6% full load

source_discrepancies: Section 2.3.5.4 computes gate-driver losses for UCC21530; the fitted BOM (TIDRZW1) lists UCC21710QDWQ1 for U29/U30/U34/U35/U37/U38/U40/U41.
Front page claims 98% full-load efficiency; Section 1.1 text states 97.6% at 10 kW while Table 1-1 lists 98.0%.
Section 4.1.1/Figure 4-7 specify a 12 V, 2.5 A auxiliary supply; Table 4-2 describes J15 as a '15V DC power supply current limited to 700mA'. The eFuse OVP is stated as 15 V.
TI product page 'Products used' list includes UCC21530 and other devices not in the E4 BOM; the BOM is treated as authoritative for fitted parts.
